question: To whom and in which direction should an offering be given after worship?
premises: Worship has been completed in the prescribed manner.
An offering is to be given afterward.
The offering is directed to Gaṇeśa in the southeast.
inference: After worship, one should give an offering to Gaṇeśa in the southeast.
plain_english: Thus, having completed the worship, one should give an offering to Gaṇeśa in the southeast.
